subtitle: Lesson 111 · Data Warehouse Concepts

steps.label: MART
steps.sub: one business function, a narrower slice of the warehouse

code:
-- WAREHOUSE: broad, whole-company analysis
SELECT d.CalendarYear, SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS f
JOIN dbo.DimDate AS d ON d.DateKey = f.OrderDateKey
GROUP BY d.CalendarYear;

-- MART: same warehouse, narrowed to ONE function
SELECT r.ResellerName, SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS Total
FROM dbo.FactResellerSales AS f
JOIN dbo.DimReseller AS r ON r.ResellerKey = f.ResellerKey
GROUP BY r.ResellerName;
caption: Not three competing choices — a mart is usually carved FROM a warehouse.
